snippet.title: S.K.I.L.L. Special Force 2 | Stream VoD for DevTalk! (with subtitles) ft. @SKILL-SpecialForce2
snippet.description:
Description:

S.K.I.L.L. Special Force 2 Stream VoD for DevTalk! You will find it out here and much more! Simply see the video!

S.K.I.L.L. - Special Force 2 is a fast-paced, action-packed shooter based on the Unreal Engine 3. The game features a wide range of game modes, tons of maps and a huge selection of weapons.
The game comes with regular content updates including new maps, game modes, weapons and other improvements!
